summary: Master central bank leadership. Learn monetary policy strategy, CBDC implementation, and financial stability frameworks in this 5-day expert-led course.
lede: Banking leadership development for central bank and financial regulatory professionals focuses on institutional direction and financial stability. It supports practical work in monetary policy design, systemic risk assessment and stress testing. Participants also develop plans for digital currency initiatives, stakeholder engagement and institutional change.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for high-level professionals within the central banking and financial regulatory ecosystem who are responsible for institutional direction and systemic stability.
audience: Central Bank Governors and Deputy Governors
modules: Modern Central Bank Mandates and Governance
Strategic Monetary Policy and Inflation Targeting
Macroprudential Policy and Systemic Risk Oversight
Leading Organizational Change and Talent Evolution
ESG Integration and Green Finance Strategy
AI and Advanced Analytics in Central Banking
prerequisites: Participants should hold a senior or mid-level management position within a central bank, ministry of finance, or financial regulatory authority. A foundational understanding of macroeconomics and financial market operations is required. Prior experience with policy drafting or banking supervision is highly recommended.
